prompt:
THE ENTIRE BACKGROUND MUST BE SOLID PURE MAGENTA, RGB(255,0,255), edge to edge, filling every pixel that is not the figure itself — a flat chroma-key backdrop, NOT white, NOT grey, NOT a coloured wash, NOT a gradient, NOT a vignette, NOT a scene, NOT a border or frame. No ground, no shadow, no horizon, no text, no watermark, no second copy of the figure, no silhouette.

The whole armor of God from Ephesians 6, worn as one complete suit by a single standing figure, drawn in the same warm hand-illustrated storybook style as the reference characters. A young soldier of no particular era standing square to the viewer, feet at the bottom edge of the frame, the whole figure inside the frame. Burnished bronze-gold plate armor with a warm painted finish, not photoreal metal: a crested helmet (the helmet of salvation), a moulded breastplate (the breastplate of righteousness), a wide cinched belt with a knotted sash (the belt of truth), simple strapped sandals (feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace). On the left arm a large round shield with a plain cross boss (the shield of faith), held slightly forward. In the right hand a straight sword held point-up at rest (the sword of the Spirit). Underneath the armor a simple undyed linen tunic, so the armor reads as worn over a pilgrim's clothing. Clean shapes, soft painted shading, no line art, no photorealism. Dignified and hopeful, not menacing — a guardian, not a warlord. Lit warmly from the upper left, colours bright enough to read at small size.
